segments.name: Container liner shipping
segments.description: A global container liner shipping company providing seaborne cargo transportation and logistics services to customers across worldwide trade lanes.
segments.evidence: The Group is managed as one operating unit, generating revenues from operating a global liner service network of cargo shipping and related services, in which lines share the use of its resources and their performance are co-dependent.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay the company for seaborne transportation of containerized cargo and vehicles, plus value-added logistics services.
revenueModel.evidence: In 2025, our 10 largest customers represented approximately 12% of our freight revenues and our 50 largest customers represented approximately 27% of our freight revenues.
